'''April 2000 St Albans tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in St Albans, England on 20 April 2000. It is known from Mike Kessling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d635">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-30-st-albans-uk-4-20-00d635/ st-albans-uk-4-20-00], DeckTech (Michael "Troop1023" Kessling, 30 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-30-st-albans-uk-4-20-00d635/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 April 2000
* '''Site:''' St Albans, England
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
